paragraphs.text: The Juniper Order was an order of druids and knights who forsook the cities of Kjeldor to live in the forests of Fyndhorn . After Fyndhorn was flooded at the end of the Ice Age, they relocated to Yavimaya .
The order worships the planeswalker Freyalise as a goddess, as do the elves of the Elvish Council who allied with the druids.
The position of Elder Druid of the Juniper Order is filled each generation by a child born with a special birthmark.
There is also a group of knights known as the Advocates of the Order . Jaeuhl Carthalion , Kaysa's lover, served as one of those Advocates.
During the later days of the Ice Age , they were led by the High Honored druid Kolbjorn . Later his daughter, Kaysa , took his place. Under Kaysa the Order helped Fyndhorn refugees get to Yavimaya .

During the period following the Great Mending , Yavimaya grew irritable and expelled the elves. Fortunately, the Juniper Order, now devoted to amity between New Argive and Yavimaya, helped to settle them in the forests of New Argive.
The current Elder Druid in the Age of Renewal , is Jenson Carthalion .
